_comment: One entry per checkbox in the settings window. `label` is the checkbox, `tooltip` says more where the label is not enough, `category` is the heading it sits under, and `sheets` lists the sheets it covers with a line saying what each holds. Sheet keys are as PackParts.SheetOf produces them: lowercase, and the nested families keep their trailing slash. A sheet appears under exactly one checkbox.

quest-text.label: Quest dialogue, journal and objectives
quest-text.tooltip: The text in the box when you talk to somebody about a quest, the summary written into your Journal as the story advances, the steps listed in the tracker, and the notices a quest posts while you are on it.

sheets.quest/: Quest dialogue, journal entries, tracker objectives and quest notices. One file per quest.

cutscenes.label: Cutscene subtitles
cutscenes.tooltip: The lines across the bottom of the screen while a cutscene is playing.

quest-names.label: Quest names
quest-names.tooltip: Only the names of quests: in the tracker, in the Journal, and in the Unending Journey at an inn. Not the text inside them.

sheets.quest: Quest titles, as the journal and the quest list show them.
sheets.completejournal: The Unending Journey and the completed-quest log. Repeats the titles above.

talk.label: Talking to someone
talk.tooltip: The box that opens when you speak to somebody who has nothing to do with a quest, including the Gold Saucer's criers and the attendants who sell you a Cactpot ticket.
talk.category: What the people around you say

sheets.defaulttalk: What an NPC says in the Talk window when there is no quest behind it.
sheets.goldsaucertalk: The Gold Saucer's barkers and the prompts before a purchase.

ask-about.label: "Ask about..." menus and service windows
ask-about.tooltip: The list of topics an NPC offers when they have several things to tell you, what they say once you pick one, and the windows you work in afterwards: the retainer, the aetheryte, the levequest board, linkshells and your estate.
ask-about.category: What the people around you say

sheets.customtalk: The topics themselves. Without it they stay English over translated answers.

balloons.label: Shouts and speech balloons
balloons.tooltip: The balloons that appear over people's heads as you walk past them, and the warnings shouted during a fight.
balloons.category: What the people around you say

sheets.npcyell: What an NPC shouts, in and out of a fight.

duty-text.label: Dialogue, objectives and on-screen text
duty-text.tooltip: What bosses and NPCs say while you are inside, the objectives that appear as it goes on, the route your party votes on in a variant dungeon, and the same for the large field zones: Eureka, Bozja, Zadnor, the Occult Crescent, the Ishgardian Restoration and the Diadem.

sheets.instancecontenttextdata: What bosses and NPCs say inside a dungeon, trial or raid.
sheets.contenttalk: NPCs you can walk up to and speak to inside a duty.
sheets.publiccontenttextdata: Dialogue and announcements in open-world content.
sheets.massivepccontenttextdata: Text from the large group content.
sheets.vvdvoteroutelabel: The variant dungeon route vote. The voting window reads this and not contenttalk, which holds the same sentence.

objects.label: What an object tells you when you use it
objects.tooltip: The message that comes back when you examine a corpse, pull a lever or open a panel, and the documents you find and read in full: expedition journals, letters, and the memos that give away a puzzle's answer.

sheets.gimmicktalk: What an object or mechanism says when you use it.
sheets.gimmickbill: Signs, notes and puzzle hints read inside a duty.

deep-dungeons.label: Deep dungeon items and gear
deep-dungeons.tooltip: The things that exist inside Palace of the Dead, Heaven-on-High and Eureka Orthos and nowhere else.

sheets.deepdungeonitem: The pomanders, each with the paragraph explaining it.
sheets.deepdungeonflooreffectui: The floor effects announced as you descend, and what each does.

phantom-jobs.label: Phantom jobs and lore log
phantom-jobs.tooltip: The Occult Crescent's own windows: the job selector, the traits inside it, and the lore log the field fills in as you explore.

sheets.mkdsupportjob: The job selector: full name, the abbreviation the HUD shows, and the paragraph under each.
sheets.mkdtrait: The trait list inside the phantom job window.

duty-finder.label: Duty Finder
duty-finder.tooltip: The Duty Finder from top to bottom: the name of every dungeon, trial and raid in the list, the roulettes and what each one asks of you, the paragraph down the right when you pick one, and the briefing a guildhest gives you as it starts.

sheets.contentfindercondition: The name of every dungeon, guildhest, trial and raid.
sheets.contentfinderconditiontransient: The description panel, one row per instance.
sheets.contentroulette: The roulettes, their short names and their descriptions.
sheets.guildorder: A guildhest's objective and its three tactical hints.

interface.label: Buttons, tabs and window titles
interface.tooltip: Everything written on the interface itself, and the Character window's attributes with the paragraph each one opens. Many other plugins look for these words in English and stop working when they are not.

sheets.addon: Every button, tab, column heading and error the game draws.
sheets.baseparam: The attributes and their tooltips. The names are also in addon, which draws the column while this draws the tooltip.

main-menu.label: Main menu
main-menu.tooltip: The menu the Esc key opens: every entry with its tooltip, and the seven headings they file under.

sheets.maincommandcategory: The seven headings. Without it the menu draws translated entries under untranslated headings.

interactables.label: Names of things you can interact with
interactables.tooltip: What the cursor reads when you point at something in the world: aetherytes and the destinations they offer, Aethernet shards, aether currents, levers, doors, gathering nodes, the signs you stop to read, and the coffers a duty leaves behind.

sheets.eobjname: The name of everything the cursor can rest on. Singular and plural, and the game picks by count.
sheets.aetheryte: Aetherytes and Aethernet shards, which the game keeps apart from other objects.
sheets.treasure: The coffers a duty leaves behind, and the loot window's own rows.

shops.label: Shop and exchange windows
shops.tooltip: The title on a vendor's window and the list of shops they offer before you pick one: the tomestone exchanges, the gear sets listed by item level, and the seasonal event stalls, with the two dropdowns an exchange window sorts its wares by.

sheets.specialshop: The name each shop window carries.
sheets.topicselect: The vendor's list of shops. Holds the same strings as specialshop, and the menu draws this one.
sheets.inclusionshopcategory: The two dropdowns at the top of an Item Exchange window.

retainer-ventures.label: Retainer ventures
retainer-ventures.tooltip: The explorer ventures a retainer is assigned. Gatherer and crafter ventures are named after the item they fetch and stay as they are.

gold-saucer-windows.label: Gold Saucer scoreboards
gold-saucer-windows.tooltip: The scoreboards and race courses. The criers themselves are under "Talking to someone".

lobby.label: Title screen and character creation
lobby.tooltip: The screens before you are in the world: logging in, choosing a character, and the races, clans and options you pick from when making one.

sheets.lobby: Title screen and character creation. Drawn before the player logs in.

active-help.label: Active Help and window help
active-help.tooltip: The windows that pop up the first time you do something, the same texts again when you look them up from the main menu afterwards, and the help behind the question mark in the corner of a window.

sheets.howto: The titles of the journal's How-to tutorials.
sheets.howtopage: The text of each tutorial page.
sheets.multiplehelpstring: The topic in the list and the page it opens.
sheets.multiplehelp: The titles of those help windows.

content-guides.label: Content guides
content-guides.tooltip: The written guide a content window opens: the rules of mahjong and Triple Triad, and the briefings for Bozja, deep dungeons, the Island Sanctuary and New Game+.

sheets.description: The window titles above those pages.
sheets.descriptionstandalonetransient: The names of the guides reached from the main menu instead.

log.label: Combat log and system messages
log.tooltip: Everything the game writes into your chat log by itself: what you hit and for how much, emotes, gil, party and Free Company notices, gathering, crafting, market board messages, and the announcements a duty makes including the red banner when a zone is sealed off.

sheets.logmessage: The whole chat log. One LogKind bucket mixes duty announcements with party invites, so there is no line to cut on.

item-names.label: Item names
item-names.tooltip: Every item in the game, as read in your bag, on the Market Board and in a tooltip.

sheets.item: Every item: the singular and plural the <ennoun> macro reads, and the name a tooltip shows.

_notInAPack.switchtalk: Conditional talk redirects. Declares no string column.
